author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

GO:0006535 | cysteine biosynthetic process from serine | IBA with P37887 , WBGene00007653 , WBGene00010759 , P0ABK5 , P9WP55 , PTN000034466 , cys11 , S000003387 , WBGene00019962 | GO_REF:0000033 | 4


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

cys12  https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC3A12.17c
and probably other fungal orthologs like
https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000003244 MCY1

although S. cerevisiae MCY1 is annotated as a putative cysteine synthase (description), but the summary says
Protein whose biological role is unknown;

However, the S. cerevisiae protein  appears to localize to the mitochondrial outer membrane (which is not where the  rest of the cysteine pathway is localized).

Also in pombe overexpression of  cys12 does not complement the cysteine synthase (cys11) deletion
https://www.pombase.org/reference/PMID:14981292
so this branch could have a different function.

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Propagation

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).

body: This also applies to GO:0004124 | cysteine synthase activity | IBA with Q76MX2 , locus:2130419 , WBGene00019962 , locus:2114804 , P9WP55 , locus:2143814 , locus:2082837 , locus:2096454 , WBGene00010759 , P37887 , WBGene00013866 , Q43153 , locus:2143754 , P0ABK5 , cys11 , WBGene00007653 , PTN000034466 , locus:2080417 , locus:2043964 oddly I see this in PomBase (I created NOTs for these because cysteine synthase is a realistic prediction) These are dated 15-02-2015, so probably can be used to block propagation in yeast.
